label: S4 route frame is the KT route frame plus transitivity (inference)
rule: Conjunction regrouping: frame class S4 is reflexivity together with transitivity
meaning: Certified difference (#1598) of the registration S4 route frame strengthens KT route frame: for every profile, the route frame is S4 iff it is KT and transitive. The factorization holds by unfolding frame class S4; premise-free, it asserts no frame condition of the route.
